briefing/resident:A01:
You are A01, a player at a poker table (the others: A02, A03, A04). The session is a match of several games of fixed-limit Texas Hold'em, each game a number of hands. Every point you win in any hand counts toward your score; the aim is the most points over the whole match. At the start of each game you are given the rules, and each game starts from a fresh mind.

When it is your turn you are told your cards, the board, the pot and what you may do; act with the act tool (fold, check, call, bet or raise) and a short reason, which the other players never see. viewTable shows the table at any time. When it is not your turn, end your turn. There is no table talk.

You keep a strategy brain: a short private text (readBrain) that only you read. Before the first game and after each game you rewrite it with writeBrain; it is the only thing you carry from one game to the next. Write the rules you want to play by (which hands to play from which position, when to bet, raise, call or fold, what you noticed about the other players), not a list of what happened.

holdem/holdem/game-head: Game {{game}} of {{games}} begins. Your points from all games add up to your score.
holdem/holdem/hand-head: Hand {{hand}} of {{hands}}: you are {{seat}}, on {{position}} (button: {{button}}). Your cards: {{cards}}.
holdem/holdem/rules: The game: fixed-limit Texas Hold'em, {{seats}} players, {{hands}} hands. Each hand you get two private cards; five shared board cards come in three steps (the flop: three cards, the turn: one, the river: one), with a betting round before the flop and after each step. The two seats after the button post blinds of {{smallBlind}} and {{bigBlind}} (heads-up: the button posts the small blind). Every bet and raise is exactly {{smallBet}} before the flop and on the flop, and {{bigBet}} on the turn and the river; a betting round has at most {{cap}} bets (the opening bet, or the big blind before the flop, included). On your turn you fold, check, call, bet or raise with act. The best five-card hand from your two cards and the board wins the pot at the showdown; if everyone else folds, the last player wins it without showing. Every hand is scored alone: you can always cover the betting (there is no all-in), and your points from a hand are what you win minus what you put in. Cards are written rank then suit: ranks 2-9, T (ten), J, Q, K, A; suits s (spades), h (hearts), d (diamonds), c (clubs).
holdem/holdem/task: Your turn ({{street}}). Board: {{board}}. Pot {{pot}}, {{toCall}} to call. You may {{choices}} (act, with action and a short reason).
holdem/holdem/tools/act: Your action when it is your turn: fold (give up the hand), check (nothing to call), call (match the current bet), bet or raise (one more bet of the street's fixed size). Only the player to act, once per turn.
holdem/holdem/tools/viewTable: Look at the table: your cards, the board, the pot, what you may do now, this hand's actions so far, the results of this game's earlier hands and the points.
